hints: One DFS is not enough: DFS only reaches one component. Loop over every vertex and start a fresh traversal from each unvisited one.
Use comp[] as both the visited array and the answer: 0 means unvisited, and a positive number is the component it belongs to.
Scanning vertices 1..n in order automatically numbers components by their smallest member, which is what the output format wants.
source: Standard DFS application (DSA theory: DFS and its applications)
title: Connected components
